name: intro
content:
Connect SquaredUp to your TeamDynamix instance.

You need a **BEID** and a **Web Services Key**. Both are on the organization detail page in **TDAdmin**, and reading them requires the *Add BE Administrators* permission — so a TeamDynamix administrator may need to supply them.

This plugin only ever reads from TeamDynamix. It never creates, updates or deletes anything.

name: apiBaseUrl
label: Web API address
help:
The address of the TeamDynamix Web API, ending in `/TDWebApi`. This is your normal TeamDynamix site address with `/TDWebApi` on the end — for example, if you sign in at `https://yourorg.teamdynamix.com/TDNext`, enter `https://yourorg.teamdynamix.com/TDWebApi`.

For a **sandbox** environment, use the sandbox Web API path instead (usually `/SBTDWebApi`).

pattern.message: Enter the full https address of your TeamDynamix Web API, e.g. https://yourorg.teamdynamix.com/TDWebApi

name: beid
label: BEID
help: Found in **TDAdmin > Organization detail**. This is a GUID identifying your TeamDynamix organization.

pattern.message: The BEID should be a GUID, e.g. 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d

name: webServicesKey
label: Web Services Key
help: Found alongside the BEID in **TDAdmin > Organization detail**. The admin service account must be set to **Active** for this key to work.

fields.name: maxRecords
fields.label: Maximum records per request
fields.help:
The TeamDynamix search endpoints return a single unpaged result set, so this caps how much is retrieved in one call. Raise it if you are missing data; lower it if requests time out or fail with a response-size error.

Applies to the assets and configuration item import, and sets the default for ticket and time entry tiles.

fields.name: ignoreCertificateErrors
fields.label: Ignore certificate errors
fields.help: Enable only if the Web API endpoint presents a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate. A self-hosted instance can still have a properly trusted certificate and should not need this.
